dataset.name: male-cns
dataset.source: neuprint.janelia.org (public /api/custom/custom cypher endpoint, no auth required)
dataset.credit: Janelia FlyEM Project Team and the Cambridge Drosophila Connectomics Group / MRC LMB, in collaboration with the Connectomics team at Google. Served via neuPrint.
dataset.note: MaleCNS v1.0 is a whole-CNS reconstruction of a single male Drosophila melanogaster (brain + ventral nerve cord). It is a different animal from FlyWire/FAFB (adult female whole brain, v783) and the two must not be mixed.

counts.note: This component ships every neuron that has a recovered soma location, regardless of proofreading status (a small ~1.2% is Orphan/Anchor -- flagged per-soma in flags.u8.bin, bit 2-3). ~24,641 Traced neurons have no recovered soma coordinate (fragment/cut off) and are not plotted -- they still exist in the connectome and its edge counts below.

regionMapping: region = FlyEM `superclass` prefix: ol_* -> optic_lobe, cb_* -> central_brain, vnc_* -> vnc; everything else (visual_projection, ascending/descending, efferent_*, ENS, unset) -> other. 'other' spans anatomical boundaries by function (e.g. a descending neuron's soma sits in the brain but it projects into the cord) so it is kept as its own honest bucket rather than forced into one side.

quantization.positions: uint16 per axis, one uniform scale for x/y/z (not independently normalised per axis) so the true elongated brain+VNC proportions are preserved. Dequantize: nm = min[axis] + raw / scale.
quantization.synapseCounts: pre/post stored as uint16, saturating at 65535 (affects 0 pre-count and 7 post-count neurons out of 141,781 -- those 7 read as '65,535+' in the UI rather than their true value).

files.positions.u16.bin: N*3 uint16, soma position, canonical row order = ascending bodyId
files.type-index.u16.bin: N uint16, index into types.json (0 = unlabeled)
files.flags.u8.bin: N uint8 = region(bits 0-1) | status(bits 2-3 << 2); region 0=central_brain 1=optic_lobe 2=vnc 3=other; status 0=Traced 1=Orphan 2=Anchor 3=unset
files.pre.u16.bin: N uint16, output (presynaptic) site count per neuron
files.post.u16.bin: N uint16, input (postsynaptic) site count per neuron
files.body-ids.u32.bin: N uint32, the real neuPrint bodyId for each row (for provenance links / lookup)
files.types.json: {regionNames, names[], counts[], region[]} -- parallel arrays, index-aligned with type-index.u16.bin
files.backbone.{src,dst}.u32.bin: 231,761 edges among soma-bearing neurons with weight >= 46, as row indices into the soma arrays above (same order)
files.edges-by-type/<type>.{src,dst}.u32.bin: every real ConnectsTo edge touching a member of <type>, in either direction, restricted to partners with a recovered soma -- row indices as above
files.edges-by-type/<type>.members.u32.bin: row indices of <type>'s own member somas

notShipped.perNeuronSkeletonMorphology: neuPrint serves real per-neuron SWC skeletons anonymously at /api/skeletons/skeleton/<dataset>/<bodyId>?format=swc; not fetched or committed in this pass. Left as documented future work rather than half-implemented against the time budget for this component.
notShipped.liveEdgeQueries: no runtime calls to neuprint from the shipped page -- everything the component uses is the static data committed here, so the visualizer works offline and does not depend on a third party's uptime.

committedByteSizes.note: measured with `du -b` over the committed files, 2026-09-18. somaLayerTotal includes types.json.
